# Shadlet repository instructions

Use the task-specific skills under `.agents/skills/`; the `review-shadlet-code` workflow is also mirrored under `.github/skills` for Copilot code review. Consult `docs/limitations.md` and the component catalogue before claiming support. Preserve protocol v2 unless a demonstrated change requires otherwise, keep Python and renderer contracts aligned, and add focused regression tests and docs for public behavior changes.
